title: Harbor Island Yacht Club
specs: Large fleet of sailboats from 22 to 42 feet and a cruising catamaran
Maximum people per boat by size: Capri 22 - 6, 27'+ boats - 8, 32'+ boats - 10, 39'+ boats - 12
Catamaran experience required for bareboat chartering Lagoon 380
US SAILING Basic Keelboat certification included with membership
Group classes limited to 4 students for Basic Keelboat, 6 for Basic Cruising and Bareboat Cruising
includes: Basic galley-ware available on multi-day reservations on request
Sailing instructor for catamaran instruction included in price if requested
blurb: Guests can rent sailboats of various sizes for half-day or full-day charters, with options for skipper assistance. Sailing lessons are offered through a US SAILING certification system, including Basic Keelboat, Basic Cruising, and Bareboat Cruising courses. Multi-day charters receive discounts and catamaran charters are available with instruction for beginners.
extraNote: Cancellation requires 72 hours notice for partial or single-day charters · 7 days notice for 2-day and regular holiday reservations · 30 days notice for 3+ day and major holiday reservations · No-shows and late cancellations charged full rental rate · Non-member refunds are not given · Optional zero liability damage waiver available for daily rate
